whatIs: BagUI is an open source library of interface blocks for React and shadcn/ui, with about 30 blocks spread across categories such as hero, features, pricing, testimonials, navigation and footer. It also offers templates, an MCP for AI assistants and a VS Code extension.
It's a good fit when you need complete, pre-built landing page sections and want to customize them in your own project.
uses: Putting together a product's home page by combining hero, features and pricing blocks.
Adding a ready-made navigation bar and footer to a project that uses shadcn/ui.
Installing blocks from VS Code or with an AI assistant connected to its MCP.
caveats: The catalog is small (about 30 blocks) and the blog category is listed as coming soon.
It requires React 19, Tailwind v4 and an already initialized shadcn/ui; blocks are installed with the shadcn CLI after you add its registry to components.json.
Some interactive blocks use Framer Motion or GSAP, so they add dependencies to your project.
pricingNote: All blocks and templates are free under the MIT license; there's only an optional sponsorship.
idealFor: Landing pages built with shadcn/ui that need ready-made sections.
